Hi, I’m Selina Wu.

I’m an aspiring marketing and strategy professional with experience in project management, brand strategy, and content creation. I’m passionate about creative solutions, storytelling, and creating unique experiences.

More about me

Nice to meet you, my name is Selina Wu! I am in my fifth year at the Schulich School of Business, specializing in marketing, strategic management, and international business. My brain lights up most when I’m coming up with solutions to creative problems through storytelling and memorable experiences.

If there is one word my friends would use to describe me, it would be passionate. Everything I choose to pick up, I pour as much energy into it as possible to achieve the best possible outcomes, whether that be through my career, leading my executive team at Schulich Women in Leadership, or my personal content creation projects.

Inspired by my parents, I marry this passion with a growth mindset and hard work. My mom and dad immigrated to Canada 24 years ago and raised my brother and me from nothing, putting us in a place of privilege they didn’t have. I strive to achieve the same level of perseverance and diligence they showed back then and still show every day.
